app.message: Net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies is not a sysctl name
sysctl net.core.somaxconn is not in the Kubernetes safe set, and Dockflow's k3s setup does not enable unsafe sysctls, so the kubelet rejects every pod of netbox with SysctlForbidden
app.hint: Remove the sysctl, or set it on the nodes themselves.
